'''Mag-grenades''' were a type of [[Grenade/Legends|grenade]].

==History==
Mag-grenades were used by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Relin Druur]] around [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]]. Around this time, at the outbreak of the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]], he used mag-grenades effectively during his [[Skirmish over Phaegon III|infiltration]] of [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Saes Rrogon]]'s [[Sith dreadnaught|dreadnaught]], [[Harbinger (Sith dreadnaught)|''Harbinger'']]. Druur utilized mag-grenades in an attempt to destroy the [[Starship/Legends|ship's]] [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]], although this was only partially successful; the ''Harbinger'' still attempted to jump into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], although it failed to completely enter its [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] and accidentally [[Time travel/Legends|traveled]] over 5,000 years through [[Time/Legends|time]] to the year [[41 ABY]].<ref name="CC">''[[Crosscurrent]]''</ref>

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Rabid Mynocks]] leader [[Quayce]] used a dud mag-grenade during a race with the leader of the [[Spiders]], [[Dean Lado]]. The grenade distracted Lado enough to cause him to be caught in a massive [[repulsor mine]]field explosion.<ref name="SG" />
